messages:
Maya (People Ops): All-hands in 20m — quick thread for logistics + QA routing. mic/check-in at the green room 14:40. Can presenters confirm availability?
Diego (Eng): I'll be there. Running HDMI -> Blackmagic test now.
Olivia (AV-Broadcast): FYI pushed a small OBS update to the laptop. Backup RTMP endpoint ready: rtmp://backup.live.redwood/allhands. If main ingest drops we'll flip manually.
Maya (People Ops): @Olivia can you set the fallback to auto if connection < 2Mbps?
Olivia (AV-Broadcast): I can set an auto-failover threshold but manual flip still recommended for audio issues.
Ava (Product): Heads-up — swapped roadmap deep-dive and Q&A blocks so leadership Qs happen after the demo. Update slide order: 8 -> 7.
Sam (CEO): OK by me. Tell folks to put product-specific Qs into the shared doc and general company Qs in this thread. I'll monitor both.
Noah (Eng-Platform): For the canary demo, I'll be sharing a short screen share. Reminder: please close slack/other windows to avoid accidental sharing.
Ethan (Eng-SRE): Noticed OBS crashed last week on similar builds. If anyone sees high CPU on the laptop please kill the duplicate ffmpeg process: 
```
ps aux | grep ffmpeg
kill -9 <pid>
```
Diego (Eng): Saw spike during a long screen share test. Will keep an eye.
DeployBot: Recording started ✅ — writing to gs://redwood-recordings/all-hands/1769501234.mp4
Maya (People Ops): Great — thanks. Quick mic checklist for presenters: 1) mic muted until cue, 2) wired headset as backup, 3) quick hello during green-room check.
Olivia (AV-Broadcast): Wired headset: yes. Also bring a 3.5mm adapter — some laptops need it.
Ava (Product): For live Qs, we'll take them via this thread and the shared doc. Can ops drop the doc link?
Maya (People Ops): Link: https://docs.google.com/.../all-hands-questions (put your name by the Q).
Sam (CEO): Two roadmap clarifications I'll address: a) Dedicated capacity SLA timeline, b) Private deployment GA window. If folks want numbers drop them in doc.
Diego (Eng): Quick check — HDMI audio sometimes gets low volume. Olivia, can you confirm gain is +6dB on switcher?
Olivia (AV-Broadcast): Yup set to +6dB. If anyone sounds faint ping me and I'll bump.
Ethan (Eng-SRE): If we lose streaming ingest we should still record local OBS file. Rules: local > backup rtmp > cloud. Set OBS to record to /tmp and rsync after show.
Noah (Eng-Platform): I'll run a small rsync watcher: `while true; do rsync -av --remove-source-files /tmp/*.mp4 gs://redwood-recordings/ ; sleep 30; done`
Maya (People Ops): Time check — 12m until start. Final call for agenda changes?
Ava (Product): No more swaps. We'll keep the adjusted order.
Sam (CEO): Quick ask to leadership: be brief on slides to leave 20m for Q.
Maya (People Ops): Noted. One last ask — if you need an offstage follow-up with a customer, tag @Ava in the doc and we'll route to Sales.
Diego (Eng): All good from Eng. See you in green room. :+1:
Olivia (AV-Broadcast): I'll be monitoring ingest and audio levels. If main goes down I'll post `:warning: fallback rtmp active` here with timestamp.
Maya (People Ops): Thanks team — see you shortly. Recording path and cleanup steps in doc.
Sam (CEO): Thanks everyone — excited for the demo.
Ava (Product): Leaving a note for post-meeting action: collect top 5 roadmap Qs and assign owners.
Maya (People Ops): Follow-up summary will be posted in #all-hands within 2 hours.
Ethan (Eng-SRE): If anyone experiences playback artifacts during the stream please paste the last 3 lines of the OBS log here and I'll triage.
Diego (Eng): Copy that.
Olivia (AV-Broadcast): Reminder: backup battery on switcher charged at 85% — should hold for >60min.
Maya (People Ops): Closing thread — sending calendar reminder 10m before start. Good luck! :sparkles:
